flags.summary: Setter qualification strictness is deliberately varied with calendar fill, so lead quality is not constant across weeks and close rates are not comparable period to period.
evidence: you notice that when calendars were a little bit lighter, you started less financially qualifying to get more momentum back on the calendar because that's what you have to do.
When the calendars are super full, you might get less sets, but you're harder financially qualifying to make sure the sets are better, like a lot better.
